title: Platform Credentials Registry
description: Schema for config/platform_credentials.yml — ADR 0438 Phase 3. Every shared credential file must have exactly one owner role declared here.

platform_credentials.description: List of all shared credential files with their owner and consumer roles.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this credential. Matches the variable name without `_local_file` suffix.

owner_role.description: The Ansible role that creates/writes/rotates this credential. Exactly one owner per credential.

consumer_roles.description: Ansible roles that read this credential. May be empty for human-only credentials.

local_file_var.description: The canonical Ansible variable name for the local artifact path. Must end in _local_file.

local_file_path.description: Default local artifact path (may contain Jinja2 templates). Single source of truth.

description.description: One-line human description of what this credential is for.

notes.description: Optional extended notes (migration history, alias tracking, etc.).
